premises.text: Post-production for reality TV is time-consuming due to inefficient communication and project management processes
premises.evidence_span: one minute of the final product takes up to 17 hours of post-production

premises.text: First Cut Pro simplifies communication and project management for video professionals
premises.evidence_span: First Cut Pro is a communication and project management tool for video professionals

premises.text: Users can create viewing rooms to provide feedback directly on videos
premises.evidence_span: all Paul needs to do is drop in a link, and he creates a viewing room

premises.text: Timestamped feedback can be collected and made actionable within the platform
premises.evidence_span: we've made it really easy by allowing users to set their own kind of quick comments

premises.text: First Cut Pro integrates with popular video editing software for seamless workflow
premises.evidence_span: we've also made it very easy for Tony to then export it directly into his favorite video editing software

premises.text: The platform is browser-based and leverages existing hosting infrastructure, making it easy for IT departments
premises.evidence_span: it's browser-based and we leverage using existing hosting infrastructure

premises.text: There is a network effect among different companies using First Cut Pro
premises.evidence_span: there's a network effect amongst different companies

premises.text: First Cut Pro can accommodate teams of all sizes and types of content being created
premises.evidence_span: teams that no matter how big or small they are, nor the type of content being created

premises.text: The platform aims to be affordable for small teams while providing value for larger clients
premises.evidence_span: we want to make it affordable for small teams, while keep on producing upsides for larger clients

premises.text: First Cut Pro is working towards meeting standards and guidelines for the Motion Picture Association of America
premises.evidence_span: we would have met all standards and guidelines for the Motion Picture Association of America

value.text: Video professionals can collaborate more efficiently and effectively through First Cut Pro
value.evidence_span: we keep on bringing post-production out of the Stone Age

notes: No separate premises for integration with Adobe and meeting MPAA standards as they are part of broader claims.
